content.text: Je voudrais trouver un emploi, dois-je d'abord obtenir un permis de travail ?

Yes, you need a specific permit to work. You cannot apply for a work permit yourself; your employer must apply for a TWV (Tewerkstellingsvergunning) from the Employee Insurance Agency (UWV). <source>1</source>[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]This permit is free of charge for the employer. You may only begin working after the UWV has approved the application and issued the permit.<source>1</source>[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]<options><option>TWV application process</option><option>Employer responsibilities</option><option>UWV contact details</option></options>
